scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "api,web" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "api,web" "INTERNAL_API_PORT=4000 node backend/dist/server.js" "npm --prefix frontend run start"
